notes.title: Tall Poppy 2 - Official Teaser Trailer
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=vbBcZyipi-w;full][/previewyoutube]

We've been working on this game since January 2022 and we finally get a chance to give you guys a small peak the world we are building! 

Many people from all over the world have been enjoying Tall Poppy and we plan on delivering a bigger, TALLER chapter in this universe. We want to thank everyone who played Tall Poppy and those who made awesome videos or live streamed themselves getting scared and laughing. We love seeing it and we hope you guys are along this new journey with us! If so, head over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2005230/Tall_Poppy_2/]Tall Poppy 2 Steam page[/url] and [b]add it it your wish list[/b]!
